methods.fetch_earth_engine: Sentinel-2 NDVI masked with the satellite's own cloud flags, zonal mean per field, weekly median of clear images, linear gap filling, Savitzky-Golay smoothing; CHIRPS rain, ERA5-Land temperature, SMAP soil moisture, Sentinel-1 water. (Signals in this build are synthetic stand-ins for Earth Engine output.)
methods.crop_calendar: Stage from days since sowing with crop-specific stage lengths; if sowing is unknown, phenology: green-up at 20% of the seasonal NDVI range, back-dated by the typical emergence time. Each stage has a weight (flowering = 1.0).
methods.anomalies: Per-field weekly climatology over 21 seasons (mean, sd, p10, p90); z-score and percentile rank; SPI-30/60/90 from a gamma fit with a zero-rain probability; soil moisture percentile.
methods.stress: Rule-based perils (drought cascade, excess water, frost, heat, hail); intensity x stage weight accumulated with exponential decay (half-life 4 weeks) into a 0-100 score; levels with hysteresis (up 25/45/70, down 20/38/62); confidence = indicator agreement x location quality x cloud-free share.
methods.analogs: Euclidean distance between this season's anomaly series to date (NDVI z, SPI-60, soil percentile) and each history season over the same weeks; the 3 closest seasons and their yield anomalies.
methods.yield_impact: Per region x crop: OLS (p50) and quantile regression (p10, p90) of department yield anomaly on season stress indicators; leave-one-year-out validation; weekly prediction from indicators available to date, wider before sowing.
methods.ifrs9: logit(PD) = logit(PD_orig) + beta x yield loss; Stage 2 on a critical alert or PD >= 2x origination, Stage 3 on BCRA situacion >= 3 or > 90 days past due; LGD x (1 - insurance cover share) with collateral adjustment; EAD from the amortization schedule; ECL = sum of marginal PD x LGD x EAD x DF monthly (12 months for Stage 1, lifetime for Stage 2/3; Stage 2 on short crop loans adds one year of assumed restructuring term); scenarios base/adverse/severe 60/25/15. IFRS 9-aligned, not audit-ready: PD adjustments are assumptions to calibrate on the lender's own data.
methods.portfolio: Weekly totals by level and stage; DBSCAN (haversine, 60 km, min 3) clusters of High/Severe loans; concentration by region and crop; historical-simulation stress test of today's book through the 21 history seasons (p95 = 1-in-20-year loss).
methods.alerts: Alerts from hysteresis-filtered level transitions; template explanations from computed numbers (optional LLM rewording, template fallback); rule-table recommendations.

meta.note: All satellite and weather signals, department yields and outcomes are SYNTHETIC. PD adjustments are assumptions to be calibrated on the lender's own data (IFRS 9-aligned, not audit-ready).
